name: Inamori Chizuru
source:
The kind and timid class president of Fuzzy Rose Colors, the class where all the problem students are gathered. Although she is hardworking and has a strong sense of responsibility, Chizuru tends to fail because of her clumsy nature and how she keeps repeating the same mistakes. She dislikes burdening others and especially her mother, as she grew up in a single-mother household.

Chizuru isn't that good with boys because they used to bully her for not having a father when she was younger. Although she can talk to them, she gets sick when one touches her.
